title: Race in opencode_combined_model_and_effort_update test: assertions read writer output before the write is established
outcome:
DIAGNOSED TO ROOT CAUSE, not labelled flaky. Found by Engram::Advisor while
gating an unrelated change; the ordering was then verified independently in
source by the coordinator.

THE TEST: tests::opencode_config::opencode_combined_model_and_effort_update_waits_for_model_specific_options
at src/tests/opencode_config.rs:1823, assertion "effort request should be
written from refreshed options".

THE CAUSE, in src/acp.rs start_acp_json_rpc_request: the function INSERTS the
request into pending_requests BEFORE it calls write_acp_json_rpc_message.
Verified by reading the function - the insert and the write are in that order,
with the write's failure path removing the entry again.

Consequently take_pending_acp_request can return as soon as the insert lands,
while the write has not happened yet. The test reads writer.contents BEFORE the
ack and the join, SO THERE IS NO HAPPENS-BEFORE RELATION FOR THE EFFORT WRITE.
The assertion is racing the writer thread.

WHY NOBODY SAW IT UNTIL NOW: the race only loses under load. Two full-suite runs
by the coordinator at this HEAD (2155 tests) passed, twice, and the test also
passes in isolation in 0.05s. It failed in a run of 2164 tests. THE DEFECT IS
PRESENT AT HEAD - it is not caused by the change that exposed it. A heavier or
differently scheduled suite is enough to reveal it, which means it will surface
again on anyone's machine as the suite grows.

FIX DIRECTION: move the content and ordering assertions AFTER the ack and the
join, so the test observes the writer's output only once the write is
established. That is a test-synchronisation fix; the OpenCode product behaviour
is not at issue.

METHOD NOTE WORTH KEEPING: the coordinator proposed a discriminating experiment
- rerun the failing suite with the nine new tests filtered out, to separate
"suite size" from "the changed code". The implementer correctly pointed out that
A PASS AFTER FILTERING WOULD NOT HAVE PROVEN ANY PARTICULAR CAUSE; it would only
have narrowed a family. Reading the source named the mechanism instead. The
experiment was a valid discriminator between hypothesis families and still the
weaker instrument here.
